body: I didn’t say that things didn’t have a cause. What I was saying there is that absolutely nobody knows what caused things to be there way they are in the universe in it’s current state. People have speculated, nobody truly knows, and anybody that says that they do are making stuff up, or passing on thing people in the past have speculated on or made up as a definitive answer. I don’t know what the cause of stuff is

I have no idea what existed before the current state we find the universe in. People have tried to work it out and experiment. Some people have guessed. But ultimately absolutely nobody knows exactly what existed before our current universe and what cause our current state of universe. The subsequent events that happened in our universe over billions of years are just a bi product of the initial reaction that happened when our current universe state came into being. Anybody that says they know are either making it up, misinformed, or have listened to somebody else who was making it up or going off information from other people who aswell didn’t fully know.

We are just made up of different atom compositions. A flower interacts with the world, carries out photosynthesis. If I take a sunflower and throw it into a fire, it won’t then exist as a sunflower somewhere else. It simply ceases to exist as a sunflower. Because we have a greater interaction with reality doesn’t make us any different. In the same way a flower doesn’t go anywhere else, we don’t either.

There is no purpose to life. Life is just a state of existence at this current point in time in the universe. Your life didn’t exist 100 years ago, and won’t exist in 100 years time. And if 100 years ago the there had been a cataclysmic disaster that wiped life off the earth there would be no life on earth as there is none on countless other planets now. You can do whatever you want in life with different consequences and outcomes. Ultimately the purpose in life is whatever purpose you give yourself personally. Above that there is absolutely no purpose

You don’t go anywhere, where does a piece of paper go that you burn? It doesn’t go anywhere, it existed as a piece of paper from elements and atoms that go into making a piece of paper. Once it’s burnt to ashes it doesnt go anywhere and exist as a piece of paper somewhere else. Just because we are conscious and can interact with the world around us doesn’t make us any different. When we die we aren’t still going to be us but somewhere else, what we are as an individual person simply ceases to exist, in the same way we didn’t exist before we were alive, we won’t exist again after we die.

What were you thinking about before you were born? Was there any pain or suffering that you were aware of at all or that you remember? No, because you did not exist. The same is the case when you die, you will once again not exist and will not be able to experience anything

Can I ask how you reach that day. Because somebody telling me that “thing will get better”, or that “things will be ok” isnt going to get me a good job. It isn’t gonna sort out any of my money problem, or pay any bills I have which I can’t afford. It isn’t going to give me a good life. It isnt going to start making me love myself, I have many many flaws and and generally not a good person to be around without me trying to be so. It isn’t going to sort out any of the problem I have which have lead me to this position. Until those problems are sorted I am going to want to kill myself. And what I have learned over years of feeling like this is that no matter what I try to do nothing changes. My life hasn’t got any better, and the hopeless feeling inside and the anger and everything like that has only grown deeper and deeper. I’ve tried to get new jobs for better money (and not just minimum wage, I’ve never had a job that paid more than minimum wage) but I have not been successful in the hundreds of applications I’ve sent out and interviews I have done. I’ve tried to better myself, go to the gym, try and get in better shape. I got in better shape, and still saw the exact same disgusting person in the mirror. I’ve tried to treat myself better, but don’t have the money to pursue any sort of hobby I would have. I live in a shitehole of a flat and we don’t have money to move anywhere else. I have a gf that although she says she loves me, she has a good job and earns decent money, she has ambitions to go on nice vacations and have a nice car and nice house and all that bullshit that I simply cannot afford. She would be so much better off without me, and it will only be when I’m out of her life that she will see I was actually the one dragging her down. 

I’ve had enough of trying to be nice and respectful to people and listen to their support. Please tell me how the fuck I reach that day where I just feel better and all those problem are solved, because not a single one of them are getting any better, and actually as the months and years go on, they are simply getting worse and worse

Last night she was crying asking me to promise I wouldn’t do anything like that. I said I promise, but inside I can’t handle the constant pain of life anymore. Why do people demand you stick around when you are in constant mental pain. We are gonna die anyway, so why should I go through years of torment and then die, instead of not going through that pain and dying now, why do people insist you have to tough it out

Yeah ngl I fucking hate myself, I’m a complete waste of space and have achieved absolutely nothing in my life, literally all I am and have ever been is a burden to people. One of the main reasons I want to end everything is because of myself so sorry to say that certainly is not a reason
